## What this does

Machine-readable truth about the release, generated — never hand-written — and
linked, never inlined (D-J3-7):

- **The exporter column registry** (`exports/column_registry.py`, new). Every
  emitted column of every columnar artifact registers description, Frictionless
  type, nullability, unit and enum source. Export-only columns are declared
  beside their writer (`*_SPECS` tuples in `compartments`, `placement`,
  `shaping`, `source_licences`, `statements`, `transparency`, `spine_export`,
  `bundle_io`). `assert_documented` fails the build on an undocumented column
  at every emit seam (bundle table writer, spine streams, transparency
  writers); `assert_path_documented` fails manifest construction on a
  row-bearing path that maps to no registered resource. Enum/slot values
  resolve from `ontology/generated` (`sig.schema.json` +
  `vocab_summary.json`) — never hand-copied — and the dictionary cites the
  generated schema by digest.
- **`dictionary.json`** (`sig.data-dictionary/1`): per-resource column docs +
  serialisation paths + Table Schema link + upstream sources, plus the
  non-columnar manifest artifacts listed as documents with their `sig.*`
  schema ids, plus the digest-pinned generated-ontology citation.
- **Table Schema per tabular resource** — `schemas/<res>.tableschema.json`
  (datapackage-profiles 2.0): required/enum constraints generated from the
  registry. This closes the J1 NEW-11 0/104 class.
- **Frictionless Data Package v2** — `datapackage.json` carries the v2
  profile, `resources[].schema` → the generated Table Schema,
  `resources[].sources`, `licenses`, `contributors`, `hash` keeping the
  `sha256:` prefix. At activation the publication-bound descriptor
  `releases/<pub>/datapackage.json` carries `version` = publication_id and
  `created` = the activation instant (unknowable at export build — recorded,
  never stubbed).
- **DCAT 3 `catalog.jsonld`** — per-bundle catalog (one `dcat:Dataset` per
  licence compartment with `dct:license`/`dct:accessRights`; each
  `dcat:Distribution` carries downloadURL/mediaType/byteSize/spdx checksum) and
  the release-registry `releases/catalog.jsonld` emitted at activation:
  `dcat:DatasetSeries` = SIG releases, `dcat:previousVersion` chained,
  `prov:wasGeneratedBy` the export run. All IRIs mint on the owned
  `surveillancegraph.org` bases (P35.38b) — `sig-project.org` never returns.
- **PROV-O `provenance.jsonld`** beside `provenance.ttl` — the same validated
  lineage graph serialised JSON-LD; `prov:generatedAtTime` stays the capture's
  true `retrieved_at`; `prov:hadPrimarySource` links each capture to its
  upstream entity where the source lane allows.
- **Linked, not inlined.** Release pages gain
  `<link rel="alternate" type="application/ld+json" href="/releases/catalog.jsonld">`
  and `<link rel="describedby">` to `release.json`/`datapackage.json`; stamped
  web pages gain the same pair in `BaseLayout`. The sitemap lists the catalog
  at the web-served `/data/catalog.jsonld` in export-mode builds (copied
  byte-for-byte; fixtures builds name nothing they cannot resolve). Zero
  inline `<script>`/JSON-LD added anywhere — the zero-JS e2e sweep stays green.
- **`/data/dictionary/`** — the public page rendering the export's own
  `dictionary.json` (fixture + export-mode data layer, `data` top-level
  allow-listed, sitemap-listed, zero scripts). A nav entry was tried and
  reverted — every nav href is a root-absolute literal counted by the
  path-containment baseline (P36.66a: shrink-only; growth needs a contract
  amendment), so the page is reached via sitemap + linked metadata instead.
- **Gates intact.** Metadata lands in the `metadata` compartment under the
  descriptor licence, manifest-listed and digest-pinned; `validate_release`
  and the publish-verify `overlay_ok` name the three activation metadata files
  explicitly; no rights/publication/compartment gate is bypassed.

## What this does not do

- No downloads centre — `/data/` slices, per-bundle ATTRIBUTION/LICENCE,
  SHA256SUMS, `/data/api/` are P36.50 (TX-10b). Bare `/data/` is a namespace
  prefix, not a page (mirrors `/artifact/`).
- No sources-table CSV/JSON download route — P36.48 owns TRANSP-033; this row
  lands the schema-generation machinery it reads.
- No CSVW (J2 S-9, deferred), no inline JSON-LD (D-J3-7 — a new-ADR path this
  row does not take), no RO-Crate change (SIG-EXPORT-002 as written).
- No `ingestion_permitted` flip, no claim-spine write, no HG gate, no publish.
  The staging-verified AC is reported at fixture-verified: no staging env
  exists — the release-build → activate → revalidate legs run inside the
  exports/ops test harnesses.
